title: nierembergia coulteri
intro: Nierembergia coulteri, commonly known as the Candytuft or Rock Candy, is a flowering plant in the phlox family native to South America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and depression. The therapeutic actions of Nierembergia coulteri include its sedative, antispasmodic, and anti-anxiety effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as phenolic acids and flavonoids. Research has also identified other bioactive compounds including coumarins and terpenoids, although the exact mechanisms of action and health benefits are still being studied.
